plain.li: [for] Faith is what keeps me going, out here.
[for] I prayed last night, and I slept better for it.
[for,subject] I hold to {SUBJECT}, whatever happens.
[for,otherideo] I wish you'd come to one of our gatherings, just to see.
[for,sameideo] It's good to share a faith with someone, isn't it.
[for,devout] I've never been surer of anything than I am of this.
[for,noideo] There's something out there looking after us, I'm sure of it.
[for,strong] Without faith we're just animals with tools.
[against] I don't know what I believe anymore.
[against] Prayers didn't stop the last raid, did they?
[against,otherideo] Your faith and mine can't both be right, can they?
[against,sameideo] Do you ever have doubts, about any of it?
[against,doubting] I went through the motions at the ritual, and felt nothing.
[against,noideo] The stars don't care about us, they're just stars.
[against,strong] The world is what we make of it, no one's watching over us.
[mixed] What do you think happens to us when we die?

warm.li: [for] I pray for all of you, you know, every night.
[against] I envy people who are sure, I really do.

blunt.li: [against] Faith's a comfort for people who can't face facts.
[for] A little faith wouldn't hurt some people round here.

cheerful.li: [for] I asked the heavens for a good harvest and a pie, and one of those came true.
[against] If there's a god, they owe me a new pair of boots.

gloomy.li: [against] If anyone's up there, they're not on our side.
[for] Faith's all we'll have left, in the end.

cold.li: [against] Belief is a habit, not evidence.
[for] Shared belief keeps a colony together; that's worth something.

plain.li: [agree,for] It's what gets me through, too.
[agree,for,sameideo] We're lucky to have each other in it.
[agree,against] I've wondered the same, more than once.
[debate,against] I'm glad it helps you, but it doesn't help me.
[debate,against,otherideo] We'll have to see whose turns out right.
[debate,for] Doubt is part of faith, my teacher used to say.
[debate,for,otherideo] Our ways are different, but I think we want the same things.
[argue,against] You'd believe anything you were told.
[argue,for] Mock it if you like, it doesn't make you right.
[argue,for,otherideo] Keep your strange beliefs to yourself.

warm.li: [debate,for] I'll pray for you anyway, if that's all right.

plain.li: [agree] Strength to us both, then.
[debate] Let's see who's right in the end.
[argue] Believe what you like, and leave me to it.
[otherfor] Praying for rain again, {OTHER}, ask for a pie while you're at it.
[otheragainst] {OTHER} doesn't believe in anything, except second helpings.
[for] We should trade more, there's a whole world out there.
[for] I'd love to know what the other settlements are like.
[for] Friends outside the walls are worth more than any wall.
[for,traders,subject] The traders from {SUBJECT} had some lovely things.
[for,caravan] That trip opened my eyes; there's so much out there.
[for,strong] We'll never be more than a camp if we hide from the world.
[against] The less we have to do with outsiders, the better.
[against] Every trader that comes is another stranger who knows our walls.
[against,traders,subject] Don't trust the {SUBJECT} lot, they've got shifty eyes.
[against,afterraid] Outsiders are trouble, the last raid proved it.
[against,strong] Out there is where the raiders come from.
[mixed] Do you ever wonder what's beyond the hills?

warm.li: [for] I hope the people out there are as decent as the people in here.

blunt.li: [for] We can't do everything ourselves, we need trade.

cheerful.li: [for] I'd trade a pig for a story from somewhere new.

gloomy.li: [against] Nobody out there cares if we live or die.

plain.li: [agree,for] I'd go on the next trip in a heartbeat.
[agree,against] We've got all we need right here.
[debate,against] Trade, fine, but let's not invite them to supper.
[debate,for] We can't stay hidden forever.
[argue,against] You'd give them the keys to the gate.
[argue,for] You'd have us living in a cave.

cheerful.li: [debate,for] Imagine the spices, though, imagine them.

plain.li: [agree] Next caravan, then.
[debate] We'll see who comes knocking.
[argue] Hide in here forever, then.
[for] A place needs beautiful things in it, or what's it all for?
[for] I stood looking at that sculpture for ages yesterday.
[for,subject] {SUBJECT} has real talent, have you seen their work?
[for,isartist] I've been working on something, I'll show you when it's ready.
[for,strong] Art is how people remember we were here.
[against] All that stone, and for what, something to look at?
[against] We need walls and beds, not statues.
[against,subject] {SUBJECT} spends a lot of time on art when there's hauling to do.
[against,strong] Every statue is a wall we didn't build.
[mixed] I don't know much about art, but I know what I don't like.

warm.li: [for] Pretty things make the hard days softer.

blunt.li: [against] Art's a waste of good stone.

cheerful.li: [for] I'm told my sculpture has a "raw energy", which means it's terrible.

gloomy.li: [against] Who'll look at it when we're gone?

plain.li: [agree,for] It lifts the place, it really does.
[agree,against] We've got better uses for our time.
[debate,against] Pretty, sure, but you can't eat it.
[debate,for] A wall keeps you alive; art reminds you why.
[argue,against] You'd carve statues while the roof fell in.
[argue,for] No wonder you're miserable, you've no soul.
[argue,against,toartist] Your hobby is eating our stone.
[agree] I'll show you my favourite piece later.
[debate] Come and look at it properly, then decide.
[argue] Enjoy your bare walls.
[for] Every new thing we learn makes life here a little easier.
[for] We should be studying more, not less.
[for,research,subject] Did you hear we worked out {SUBJECT}?
[for,strong] Knowledge is the only thing raiders can't steal.
[against] The old ways worked for a thousand years, why change now?
[against] Every new thing we build is another thing to break.
[against,research,subject] {SUBJECT} sounds clever, but I don't trust it.
[against,strong] We're forgetting how to do things with our own hands.
[mixed] I can't keep up with all the new ideas, honestly.

warm.li: [for] I love watching the clever ones work things out.

blunt.li: [for] Stop being afraid of anything new.

cheerful.li: [for] I learned something new today, and I've already forgotten it.

gloomy.li: [against] Clever things fail in clever ways.

plain.li: [agree,for] We'll be better off for it.
[agree,against] There's a lot to be said for the old ways.
[debate,against] New isn't always better.
[debate,for] The old ways were new once, too.
[argue,against] You'd swap your hands for a gadget if you could.
[argue,for] You'd still be living in a cave if it were up to you.
[agree] Here's to learning, then.
[debate] Time will tell.
[argue] Stay in the past, then.
